parsed.text: This packet contains two panels (p0, p1) of fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3. Grids use rows increasing downward and columns increasing rightward. Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are hypothetical estimates, not executed events. Current (panel p0) summary: n0 — blue concentrated at (0,1) (peak ≈0.99996), red at (0,3) (peak ≈0.99971); n1 and n2 — uniform over all 16 cells; n3 — blue concentrated at (1,2) (peak ≈0.8166), red concentrated at (1,2) (peak ≈0.3287). Panel p1 current mirrors p0 for n0–n2; n3 current has blue concentrated on the four cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) and red concentrated on the four cells (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1). Conditional command candidates differ: for p0 n3 the blue/red concentration and peak probabilities vary across k0/k1/k2; for p1 n3 k0,k1,k2 show different peak sets and magnitudes (k2 shifts blue to (1,2) and red to (0,1) with very large peak probabilities). No field measures or external facts are inferred; these are summaries of the supplied distributions only.
